The Ryan White Part D grant provides services to women and youth under 25. Patients currently enrolled in the Ryan White program are eligible for medication and copay support, transportation vouchers, as well as medical, lab, dental,  and psychosocial services provided by staff supported by program income from 340B revenue. Part D funds also support the Women's support group,  Youth support group and Yoga classes provided in our clinic space as well as community outreach at public events like PRIDE and World AIDS Day. We also host regularly scheduled events at local libraries and community centers  that provide free HIV testing  and  link patients to care and resources. Ryan White grant programs are audited annually for program integrity both internally and by the funding source.
